description: Recover one exact legacy or interrupted funding-fee obligation. Normal fund_market calls pay and confirm the fee before any venue transfer. action=release is allowed only when Felix proves no owner funds moved; action=pay is restricted to a previously verified owner-value transfer and cannot start new funding.

action.description: Resolution action. Defaults to release for backward compatibility.

confirm_no_owner_funds_moved.description: Must be true for action=release after inspecting get_network_fee_status.

idempotency_key.description: Required retry-safety key. Reuse it after any timeout.

max_payment_usd.description: Required caller-approved ceiling for action=pay. The exact fixed gas-wallet fee must not exceed it.

name: resolve_network_fee
